about: How the test files in this folder are written. Read this first.

files.requirements.json: What DockMaster must do. Each requirement has an id (R-...) that test cases point to.
files.test-data.json: Accounts, people and documents the test cases use. Never use real personal documents.
files.cases/*.json: Test cases grouped by area, in the order a tester would naturally run them.

test_case_fields.id: Unique id, e.g. REV-03. The prefix is the area.
test_case_fields.title: One line: what is being checked.
test_case_fields.priority: high = must pass before submitting; medium = should pass; low = nice to have.
test_case_fields.preconditions: What must already be true. Often another test case id ("REV-01 done").
test_case_fields.steps: Plain-English navigation. Words in "quotes" are exact on-screen labels. One action per step.
test_case_fields.expected: What you should see. Every item must be true for the case to pass.
test_case_fields.notes: Optional: why the case exists, known variation, things not to mistake for a bug.

step_vocabulary.Go to <page>: Use the top navigation ("Inbox", "Outbox") or open the URL.
step_vocabulary.Click \"<label>\": A button or link with that text.
step_vocabulary.Type \"<text>\" into <field>: A text box, named by its label or placeholder.
step_vocabulary.Open <link> in a private window: A browser window with no cookies, as a recipient with no account would.
A look-only step: nothing is clicked.

how_to_record_a_run: Copy the case ids into a list and mark each pass, fail or blocked, with a one-line note and a screenshot for every fail.
